Self-reference. ParentAccountID points to another row in the same table. The highlighted ParentAccountID (11) is the AccountID of Fixed Assets, so Furniture and Fixtures sits under Fixed Assets.
AccountSubType marks summary accounts as Header, and no entries post to them. Current assets are identified by their subtype, not by a parent account.
